$comment: Ground truth for sub-phase 2.9: which sheet a placeholder inherits from, what descends the chain, what p:bgRef and a:fillRef index, and which colour map is in force. Every number here was read out of PowerPoint through its own object model rather than measured from a bitmap: a placeholder that states no geometry still has a position, PowerPoint knows it, and Shape.Left reports it in points. Generated by tools/ground-truth/analyse-sheets.ts from decks written by build-sheet-deck.ts.
